## Context / Problem
The code-review `tests` overlay (blocking at 0.54 —
`src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json:110-119`) is selected only when a changed file
matches `**/test_*.py`, `**/*_test.py`, `**/tests/**` (`registry.py:295-311`,
`glob_triggered_overlays`). A change adding product logic and touching no test file never runs the
overlay unless the base reviewer recommends it, and guard (vii)
(`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md:97`) keeps a bare coverage-gap finding advisory.

Four changes adding definitions under `src/` merged on `LLM-Review +1` with zero test files: Gerrit
388 (`d9e0f0e733`, 15 added `def`/`class` lines, new `git_adapter.py`), 1920 (`721cb7d6ac`, 3), 1737
(`1c2bf6e57b`, 22), 1703 (`83d91d488c`, 8). 388 later produced three bugs — `79c6-eaf3-38af-4ce9`,
`b0a8-5496-d178-40a9`, `cfe1-3572-4536-49d3`, the `git_adapter` by-path-load family the epic names. Gerrit 1547 (`24917e843b`) is NOT in this population:
its src delta is comment-only (0 added `def`/`class` lines, 0 added branch lines) and it changed
four docs files, so it is a NEGATIVE case. Approved in the fortnight defect review (2026-08-21);
diff-coverage was rejected — the project tests behaviour, not coverage %.

## Approach
Fire the `tests` overlay from the diff CONTENT, in the one place that knows both the diff and the
changed files.
1. `registry.content_triggered_overlays` (`registry.py:416`) takes `(diff_text, repo_root)` only and
   is path-blind by construction (every helper skips the `+++`/`---` headers), so the "changes no
   file under `tests/**`" half of the rule cannot be computed there today. Add a keyword-only
   `changed_files: Sequence[str] = ()` — existing call sites and tests keep working positionally —
   and pass the step's `changed` list at `workflow_ops.py:99`.
2. The detector is a NEW module-level helper (`_has_added_definition`), NOT extra branches inside
   `content_triggered_overlays`: `scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` fails on `new>0` and
   the baseline may not be raised. It fires when an ADDED (`+`) line under a `src/**` file header
   starts a function/method/class definition or a new conditional branch, AND no changed file
   matches the `tests` globs. Provenance is tracked per `diff --git`/`+++ b/` header, as the
   composed context interleaves files.
3. Two suppressions, both required by the corpus: an added definition line differing from a removed
   one in the same hunk only by type annotations, whitespace or decorators does NOT count (1703's
   shape); comment-only and blank-line additions never count (1547's shape). A file MOVE is NOT
   suppressed: the reviewed diff is `git diff base...head` with no `-M` (`assemble.py:230`), so a
   rename arrives as delete + add, indistinguishable from new definitions — 1920 and 1737 trigger,
   by design.
4. The detector runs against the COMPOSED context, not a raw diff: `overlay_union` receives
   `steps.assemble_diff.outputs.context` (`gates/code-review.yaml:64`, `:118`) — a
   `## Changed files` list plus the diff truncated at `DIFF_CHAR_CAP = 60000` (`assemble.py:30`,
   `compose_diff_context` `:78-93`). Tests must exercise BOTH shapes. Blind spot, recorded: a
   definition added past the cap does not trigger. `changed_files` is unaffected by truncation,
   which is why the negative half of the rule is keyed on it, not the diff text.
5. Narrow guard (vii) in `code-review-tests.md:97` so a gap on *newly introduced* behaviour with a
   named violating input is blocking-eligible, while a gap on pre-existing code stays advisory. It
   is ONE prompt shared by Round-A and Round-B, so this also changes blocking eligibility for the
   existing glob-triggered population (calibrated at 0.54, "blocks 99 changes / 8.0%") — intended;
   the eval corpus gains the pre-existing-code FP case so both halves are covered.
6. `criteria_routing.json` gains trigger provenance in the `tests` entry's `_comment` only; its
   committed `applies_to` globs are unchanged. A project overlay cannot do this job:
   `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` has no `tests` entry, and `registry.project_trigger_extensions`
   (`registry.py:254`) offers only literal `trigger_tokens` and additive `applies_to` globs —
   neither expresses "adds a definition AND touches no `tests/**`".

## Scope
In `src/rebar/llm/code_review/`:
- `registry.py` — `changed_files` kwarg + `_has_added_definition`.
- `workflow_ops.py` — pass `changed` at the `content_triggered_overlays` call (`:99`) and refresh
  the step's `description=` (`:70-86`), which names deletion-impact as the only content trigger.
- `criteria_routing.json` — `tests` `_comment` provenance only.

Elsewhere:
- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md` — guard (vii), `:97`.
- `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-tests.eval.yaml` — one recall case (gap on new behaviour) +
  one FP case (pre-existing code), keeping `test_code_review_dataset_balanced` green.
- `tests/unit/test_code_review_tests_trigger.py` (new; flat layout — no `tests/unit/llm/` package).

Accepted consequences, deliberately unchanged: the Pass-4 coach moves keyed on the `tests` tag
(`moves.py:26-31`, `:74-84`) now offer on ordinary src changes; Round-A is uncapped (`cap: 3` is
only on the Round-B `union` step, `code-review.yaml:118`), so each qualifying change costs one
extra frontier overlay call.

## Testing
Pinning, under `tests/unit/`: `test_code_review_triggers.py`, `test_code_review_deletion_impact.py`,
`test_code_review_evals.py` (58 tests, green at baseline) pass unchanged — their fixtures use
non-`src/` paths or removed definitions, so no equality assertion flips.
`scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py` and `test_criteria_vocabulary_reviewers.py` cover the prompt
edit; `test_prompt_index.py` is NOT a gate here (`code-review-pass` prompts are excluded from
`reviewers/index.json`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A diff whose only `src/**` addition is a function/method/class definition, with no changed file
  under `tests/**`, selects `tests` from `registry.content_triggered_overlays`, and through
  `overlay_union` sets `include_tests` true; asserted on BOTH a raw diff and the
  `compose_diff_context` output for it. Checked by
  `pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_tests_trigger.py -q`.
- [ ] Parametrised replay over synthetic diffs reproducing each cited shape: SELECT for
  `d9e0f0e733` (new module, 15 added definitions), `721cb7d6ac` (moved definitions, 3),
  `1c2bf6e57b` (module split, 22); DO NOT SELECT for `24917e843b` (comment-only `src/` delta —
  `git show 24917e843b -- 'src/*' | grep -cE '^\+\s*(async +)?(def|class) '` returns `0`) and
  `83d91d488c` (annotation-only signature rewrite). Checked by the same test.
- [ ] Docs-only, config-only and test-file-only diffs do not content-select it; a diff adding a `def`
  under `src/` *plus* a `tests/` file still selects it by glob (union, not replacement). Checked by
  the same test.
- [ ] Existing trigger pinning is byte-identical: `pytest
  tests/unit/test_code_review_triggers.py tests/unit/test_code_review_deletion_impact.py -q` passes
  unedited (46 tests, green before and after).
- [ ] Guard (vii) at `code-review-tests.md` distinguishes newly-introduced from pre-existing
  behaviour and the Four-Criterion Test bullet is unchanged; asserted in the same test file via
  `prompts.get_prompt("code-review-tests")`.
- [ ] Reviewer-prompt, eval-corpus and repo gates pass with no baseline edit: `pytest
  tests/unit/test_code_review_evals.py tests/unit/test_criteria_vocabulary_reviewers.py -q`,
  `python scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`, and
  `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` reporting `new=0 increased=0` with
  `registry.py` under the 800-line cap in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`.
